probes.clarity: I could follow the next-floor goal, but “King · slain 100%” appeared while my lineage had only died to him and still showed D34 behind him.
probes.decisions: I kept the unknown-scroll patch that replayed “9/12” instead of a return patch that saved “12/12” but cut Mother reach from “83→17%,” because I wanted progress as well as safety.
probes.mastery: I now distinguish arrival from victory: switching to “mirror read L5” raised D33 arrival “13→63%” while D34 remained “<13%,” so I kept a separate King rhythm counter.
probes.tension: I watched Petra at “3/18 hp” with gas damage and no heals, then her emergency scroll sequence banked “$584,” which made the saved carry feel earned.
probes.feel: The armour purchase responded visibly and the sword arcs, hit numbers and “BLOCKED” made impacts readable, though I did not hear audio and did not click just for its sensation.
probes.surprise: Mother gas forced an unknown-scroll bailout, Queen summons forced “read silence,” and wardens reflecting melee made me replace archer kiting with “mirror read.”
probes.expression: My cautious build used “depth ≥28 → read silence,” “depth ≥33 → second wind,” early heals, a low-health recall and a corridor rule above two mirror packages.
probes.story: Petra went into Mother's gas with no heals; my last-resort unknown scroll first enchanted and then recalled her; she escaped with “banked $584” instead of becoming the next heir.
probes.pacing: I wanted another King attempt, but a D28 “Live” view stopped changing until pause/resume, and long rule lists made my return decisions slower than the compact reports.
probes.failure: Rook lost after “second wind · no use,” an empty heal slot and “bank at44% · going home” at16/54, then an18-damage King hit finished him, so my preparation and thresholds mattered.
probes.social: I kept old guard ogre Drul after “served 3” and his grudge because he had survived several heirs, but I played with no other person.
probes.autonomy: I chose to retain “GUARD ·32HP” Drul instead of the newly tamed “SCOUT ·24HP” eel, and tested scroll bailouts rather than opting into the offered Lich trial.
probes.progression: Runs grew carry and an “axe +13,” persistent growth reached FighterL7 and six custom slots, and hired workers removed sending, packing, forging and training chores, including “Drillmaster +9 levels.”
probes.aesthetic: The torchlit crypts, red Foundry and grey Sanctum made the descent feel like a place, though the little hero and enemies sometimes overlapped and the phone header truncated “unbow…”.
probes.return: I returned to a new D31 record after20m, a Queen death and “−$9000 · forge” after4h, and “4 runs · +$13121” plus King failures after8h, then chose patches, counters and supplies rather than wishing I had stayed.
probes.attribution: I deliberately reserved silence for “depth ≥28” and saw “boss → read silence” wipe Queen's summoned lurkers; my scoped second wind was consumed by a D33 warden and was unavailable against the King.
